cause_quote: The new `if (!previousEditedInPlace && (valuesUnchanged || matchesPublished)) { return; }` guard skipped publication before the authored source snapshot could be updated.
user_saw: A plugin disabled by default was still rejected after the operator explicitly enabled it in a config update that left the resolved runtime values unchanged.
summary: The fix publishes changes to authored config values or resolution provenance even when resolved runtime values stay equal, while preserving narrow refresh scopes.
reasoning: I checked the causing diff and its parent. The parent already accepted source-only updates and replaced the stored source snapshot even when it suppressed the session-change event. The causing commit moved the equality check ahead of the source assignment, leaving plugin policy readers with stale authored settings.
